body:
## Pull request overview

This PR optimizes CI performance by consolidating redundant workflows and removing placeholder tests. It reduces workflow count from 14 to 12 and test files from 215 to 211, while introducing artifact sharing between jobs to eliminate duplicate builds.

**Changes:**
- Merged `size-check.yml` into `performance-budget.yml` (renamed to "Bundle Analysis") to perform both console performance budget checks and per-package size reporting in a single build
- Merged `visual-regression.yml` into `storybook-tests.yml` as a conditional step that only runs on pull requests
- Implemented build artifact sharing between build and E2E jobs, eliminating ~3.5min rebuild in E2E
- Added conditional execution to docs job to skip builds when no docs files changed
- Removed 4 trivial placeholder test files superseded by comprehensive test suites

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
